sources.title: Install and manage digital assets
claimsUsed: HDA definitions can come from multiple library files discovered through Houdini paths.
Users can choose among multiple definitions of one asset.
Embedded definitions and external libraries have a configurable preference order.

sources.title: Editing digital assets
claimsUsed: Unlocked instances can contain in-memory edits that differ from the saved definition.
Matching the current definition discards unsaved instance changes and relocks the node.

sources.title: Digital assets versions and namespaces
claimsUsed: Ambiguous type names are resolved using version, scope, namespace and environment hierarchy rules.
Exact type-name resolution is separately available.
The Type Properties Version field is independent of the version suffix in the type name.

sources.title: hou.HDADefinition
claimsUsed: HOM exposes library path, node type name, current/preferred state and definition contents.
The user-defined version string is application-managed rather than an immutable payload identity.
An unlocked instance does not automatically update when its definition changes.

independence: All sources are one official SideFX documentation lineage; they are primary documentation but not independent runtime observations.
